title: The Great Wall has a toboggan exit — Mutianyu | Beijing, Walked EP1 | China Travel Expert
description:
Chairlift up through the mist. Toboggan down the mountain.

Real footage from Mutianyu Great Wall, Beijing: the morning cable lift, and the metal slide that carries you all the way down. Yes, it's real, and yes, you can ride it.

🧭 Expert Tip: come early — morning mist on the lift, no crowds on the slide.
